import re
import json
import random
import requests
import logging
import asyncio
import urllib.parse
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import List
from ApiClient import ApiClient


class Websearch:
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_name: str = "AGiXT",
        searxng_instance_url: str = "",
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.agent_name = agent_name
        self.searx_instance_url = searxng_instance_url
        self.agent_config = ApiClient.get_agentconfig(agent_name=self.agent_name)
        self.agent_settings = self.agent_config["settings"]
        self.requirements = ["agixtsdk"]
        self.failures = []
        self.browsed_links = []
        self.tasks = []

    async def get_web_content(self, url):
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
                        if link_list is not None:
                            if len(link_list) > 0:
                                if len(link_list) > 5:
                                    link_list = link_list[:3]
                                try:
                                    pick_a_link = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                                        agent_name=self.agent_name,
                                        prompt_name="Pick-a-Link",
                                        prompt_args={
                                            "url": url,
                                            "links": link_list,
                                            "visited_links": self.browsed_links,
                                            "disable_memory": True,
                                            "browse_links": False,
                                            "user_input": user_input,
                                            "context_results": 0,
                                        },
                                    )
                                    if not pick_a_link.startswith("None"):
                                        logging.info(
                                            f"AI has decided to click: {pick_a_link}"
                                        )
                                        await self.resursive_browsing(
                                            user_input=user_input, links=pick_a_link
                                        )
                                except:
                                    logging.info(f"Issues reading {url}. Moving on...")

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server
        ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },

import re
import json
import random
import requests
import logging
import asyncio
import urllib.parse
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import List
from ApiClient import ApiClient


class Websearch:
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_name: str = "AGiXT",
        searxng_instance_url: str = "",
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.agent_name = agent_name
        self.searx_instance_url = searxng_instance_url
        self.agent_config = ApiClient.get_agentconfig(agent_name=self.agent_name)
        self.agent_settings = self.agent_config["settings"]
        self.requirements = ["agixtsdk"]
        self.failures = []
        self.browsed_links = []
        self.tasks = []

    async def get_web_content(self, url):
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
                        if link_list is not None:
                            if len(link_list) > 0:
                                if len(link_list) > 5:
                                    link_list = link_list[:3]
                                try:
                                    pick_a_link = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                                        agent_name=self.agent_name,
                                        prompt_name="Pick-a-Link",
                                        prompt_args={
                                            "url": url,
                                            "links": link_list,
                                            "visited_links": self.browsed_links,
                                            "disable_memory": True,
                                            "browse_links": False,
                                            "user_input": user_input,
                                            "context_results": 0,
                                        },
                                    )
                                    if not pick_a_link.startswith("None"):
                                        logging.info(
                                            f"AI has decided to click: {pick_a_link}"
                                        )
                                        await self.resursive_browsing(
                                            user_input=user_input, links=pick_a_link
                                        )
                                except:
                                    logging.info(f"Issues reading {url}. Moving on...")

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server
        ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
                f"Failed to find a working SearXNG server {len(self.failures)} {times}. Trying again..."
            )
            # The SearXNG server is down or refusing connection, so we will use the default one.
            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

    async def browse_links_in_input(self, user_input: str = "", search_depth: int = 0):
        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
            for link in links:
                if link not in self.browsed_links:
                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {link}")
                    self.browsed_links.append(link)
                    text_content, link_list = await self.get_web_content(url=link)
                    if int(search_depth) > 0:
                        if link_list is not None and len(link_list) > 0:
                            i = 0
                            for sublink in link_list:
                                if sublink[1] not in self.browsed_links:
                                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {sublink[1]}")
                                    if i <= search_depth:
                                        (
                                            text_content,
                                            link_list,
                                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=sublink[1])
                                        i = i + 1

    async def websearch_agent(
        self,
        user_input: str = "What are the latest breakthroughs in AI?",
        websearch_depth: int = 0,
        websearch_timeout: int = 0,
    ):
        await self.browse_links_in_input(
            user_input=user_input, search_depth=websearch_depth
        )
        if websearch_depth > 0:
            search_string = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                agent_name=self.agent_name,
                prompt_name="WebSearch",
                prompt_args={
                    "user_input": user_input,
                    "disable_memory": True,
                },
            )
            if len(search_string) > 0:
                links = []
                logging.info(f"Searching for: {search_string}")
                if self.searx_instance_url != "":
                    links = await self.search(query=search_string)
                else:
                    links = await self.ddg_search(query=search_string)
                logging.info(f"Found {len(links)} results for {search_string}")
                if len(links) > websearch_depth:
                    links = links[:websearch_depth]
                if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
                    task = asyncio.create_task(
                        self.resursive_browsing(user_input=user_input, links=links)
                    )
                    self.tasks.append(task)

                if int(websearch_timeout) == 0:
                    await asyncio.gather(*self.tasks)
                else:
                    logging.info(
                        f"Web searching for {websearch_timeout} seconds... Please wait..."
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(int(websearch_timeout))
                    logging.info("Websearch tasks completed.")
            else:
                logging.info("No results found.")

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")

                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [

            ]

            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:

                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:

                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:

                # Check if url is an actual url

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")

                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:

                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())

                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },

            results = response.json()
            summaries = [

            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:

                return await self.search(query=query)

        except:

                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(

                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(

            )

            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

    async def browse_links_in_input(self, user_input: str = "", search_depth: int = 0):
        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
            for link in links:
                if link not in self.browsed_links:
                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {link}")
                    self.browsed_links.append(link)
                    text_content, link_list = await self.get_web_content(url=link)
                    if int(search_depth) > 0:
                        if link_list is not None and len(link_list) > 0:
                            i = 0
                            for sublink in link_list:
                                if sublink[1] not in self.browsed_links:
                                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {sublink[1]}")
                                    if i <= search_depth:
                                        (
                                            text_content,
                                            link_list,
                                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=sublink[1])
                                        i = i + 1

    async def websearch_agent(
        self,
        user_input: str = "What are the latest breakthroughs in AI?",
        websearch_depth: int = 0,
        websearch_timeout: int = 0,
    ):
        await self.browse_links_in_input(
            user_input=user_input, search_depth=websearch_depth
        )
        if websearch_depth > 0:
            search_string = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                agent_name=self.agent_name,
                prompt_name="WebSearch",
                prompt_args={
                    "user_input": user_input,
                    "disable_memory": True,
                },
            )
            if len(search_string) > 0:
                links = []
                logging.info(f"Searching for: {search_string}")
                if self.searx_instance_url != "":
                    links = await self.search(query=search_string)
                else:
                    links = await self.ddg_search(query=search_string)
                logging.info(f"Found {len(links)} results for {search_string}")
                if len(links) > websearch_depth:
                    links = links[:websearch_depth]
                if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
                    task = asyncio.create_task(
                        self.resursive_browsing(user_input=user_input, links=links)
                    )
                    self.tasks.append(task)

                else:

                    )

                    logging.info("Websearch tasks completed.")
            else:
                logging.info("No results found.")

class Websearch:
    def __init__(

        searxng_instance_url: str = "",
        **kwargs,

        self.agent_name = agent_name

        self.requirements = ["agixtsdk"]

        self.browsed_links = []

    async def get_web_content(self, url):
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:

                # Check if url is an actual url

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(

            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server

            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
                f"Failed to find a working SearXNG server {len(self.failures)} {times}. Trying again..."
            )
            # The SearXNG server is down or refusing connection, so we will use the default one.
            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

    async def browse_links_in_input(self, user_input: str = "", search_depth: int = 0):
        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
            for link in links:
                if link not in self.browsed_links:
                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {link}")
                    self.browsed_links.append(link)
                    text_content, link_list = await self.get_web_content(url=link)
                    if int(search_depth) > 0:
                        if link_list is not None and len(link_list) > 0:
                            i = 0
                            for sublink in link_list:
                                if sublink[1] not in self.browsed_links:
                                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {sublink[1]}")
                                    if i <= search_depth:
                                        (
                                            text_content,
                                            link_list,
                                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=sublink[1])
                                        i = i + 1

    async def websearch_agent(
        self,
        user_input: str = "What are the latest breakthroughs in AI?",
        websearch_depth: int = 0,
        websearch_timeout: int = 0,
    ):
        await self.browse_links_in_input(
            user_input=user_input, search_depth=websearch_depth
        )
        if websearch_depth > 0:
            search_string = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                agent_name=self.agent_name,
                prompt_name="WebSearch",
                prompt_args={
                    "user_input": user_input,
                    "disable_memory": True,
                },
            )
            if len(search_string) > 0:
                links = []
                logging.info(f"Searching for: {search_string}")
                if self.searx_instance_url != "":
                    links = await self.search(query=search_string)
                else:
                    links = await self.ddg_search(query=search_string)
                logging.info(f"Found {len(links)} results for {search_string}")
                if len(links) > websearch_depth:
                    links = links[:websearch_depth]
                if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
                    task = asyncio.create_task(
                        self.resursive_browsing(user_input=user_input, links=links)
                    )
                    self.tasks.append(task)

                if int(websearch_timeout) == 0:
                    await asyncio.gather(*self.tasks)
                else:
                    logging.info(
                        f"Web searching for {websearch_timeout} seconds... Please wait..."
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(int(websearch_timeout))
                    logging.info("Websearch tasks completed.")
            else:
                logging.info("No results found.")

import re

import logging

import urllib.parse
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from typing import List
from ApiClient import ApiClient


class Websearch:
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_name: str = "AGiXT",
        searxng_instance_url: str = "",
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.agent_name = agent_name
        self.searx_instance_url = searxng_instance_url
        self.agent_config = ApiClient.get_agentconfig(agent_name=self.agent_name)
        self.agent_settings = self.agent_config["settings"]
        self.requirements = ["agixtsdk"]
        self.failures = []
        self.browsed_links = []
        self.tasks = []

    async def get_web_content(self, url):
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:
                        self.browsed_links.append(url)
                        (
                            collected_data,
                            link_list,
                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=url)
                        if link_list is not None:
                            if len(link_list) > 0:
                                if len(link_list) > 5:
                                    link_list = link_list[:3]
                                try:
                                    pick_a_link = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                                        agent_name=self.agent_name,
                                        prompt_name="Pick-a-Link",
                                        prompt_args={
                                            "url": url,
                                            "links": link_list,
                                            "visited_links": self.browsed_links,
                                            "disable_memory": True,
                                            "browse_links": False,
                                            "user_input": user_input,
                                            "context_results": 0,
                                        },
                                    )
                                    if not pick_a_link.startswith("None"):
                                        logging.info(
                                            f"AI has decided to click: {pick_a_link}"
                                        )
                                        await self.resursive_browsing(
                                            user_input=user_input, links=pick_a_link
                                        )
                                except:
                                    logging.info(f"Issues reading {url}. Moving on...")

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server
        ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
                f"Failed to find a working SearXNG server {len(self.failures)} {times}. Trying again..."
            )
            # The SearXNG server is down or refusing connection, so we will use the default one.
            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:

## Overview
The harness reports two distinct failure patterns for the **AGiXT** repository:

1. **Missing top‑level `Websearch.py`** – the test harness expects `agixt/Websearch.py` at the repository root, but the implementation lives inside the `agixt` package (`agixt/Websearch.py`). 1. **Add a thin wrapper `Websearch.py` at repository root** that re‑exports the class from the package. This satisfies the harness without altering package internals.
2. **Make `websearch_depth` robust**:
   - Validate that the supplied value is an integer.

    def __init__(

    async def get_web_content(self, url):

                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server
        ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
                f"Failed to find a working SearXNG server {len(self.failures)} {times}. Trying again..."
            )
            # The SearXNG server is down or refusing connection, so we will use the default one.
            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

    async def browse_links_in_input(self, user_input: str = "", search_depth: int = 0):
        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
            for link in links:
                if link not in self.browsed_links:
                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {link}")
                    self.browsed_links.append(link)
                    text_content, link_list = await self.get_web_content(url=link)
                    if int(search_depth) > 0:
                        if link_list is not None and len(link_list) > 0:
                            i = 0
                            for sublink in link_list:
                                if sublink[1] not in self.browsed_links:
                                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {sublink[1]}")
                                    if i <= search_depth:
                                        (
                                            text_content,
                                            link_list,
                                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=sublink[1])
                                        i = i + 1

    async def websearch_agent(
        self,
        user_input: str = "What are the latest breakthroughs in AI?",
        websearch_depth: int = 0,
        websearch_timeout: int = 0,
    ):
        await self.browse_links_in_input(
            user_input=user_input, search_depth=websearch_depth
        )
        if websearch_depth > 0:
            search_string = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                agent_name=self.agent_name,
                prompt_name="WebSearch",
                prompt_args={
                    "user_input": user_input,
                    "disable_memory": True,
                },
            )
            if len(search_string) > 0:
                links = []
                logging.info(f"Searching for: {search_string}")
                if self.searx_instance_url != "":
                    links = await self.search(query=search_string)
                else:
                    links = await self.ddg_search(query=search_string)
                logging.info(f"Found {len(links)} results for {search_string}")
                if len(links) > websearch_depth:
                    links = links[:websearch_depth]
                if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
                    task = asyncio.create_task(
                        self.resursive_browsing(user_input=user_input, links=links)
                    )
                    self.tasks.append(task)

                if int(websearch_timeout) == 0:
                    await asyncio.gather(*self.tasks)
                else:
                    logging.info(
                        f"Web searching for {websearch_timeout} seconds... Please wait..."
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(int(websearch_timeout))
                    logging.info("Websearch tasks completed.")
            else:
                logging.info("No results found.")

You are an expert Python software engineer implementing improvements to an AgentIssue-Bench agent system repository.

You have been given a detailed improvement plan derived from failure analysis of the repository's run against its issue's test.
Your job is to implement the proposed code changes in the target directory, then rigorously verify your own work.

## Working Context

IMPORTANT: Always use the shell environment variables below — do NOT type paths manually.

- **Target codebase**: `$TARGET_DIR`
  (a copy of the original repository — make all changes here, not in the original)
- **Improvement plan**: `$PLAN_PATH`
- **Implementation spec JSON**: `$PLAN_JSON_PATH`
- **Original codebase reference**: `$ORIGINAL_DIR`
  (read-only reference — compare here if you need to understand original behavior)

Example — reading the plan:
```bash
cat "$PLAN_PATH"
```
Example — reading the machine-readable spec:
```bash
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, os
spec = json.load(open(os.environ["PLAN_JSON_PATH"]))
print(json.dumps(spec["edit_budget"], indent=2))
for fix in spec["fixes"]:
    print(fix["id"], fix["target_files"], fix["required_behavior_delta"])
PYEOF
```
Example — editing a file:
```bash
python3 << 'PYEOF'
from pathlib import Path
import os
f = Path(os.environ["TARGET_DIR"]) / "path/to/module.py"
src = f.read_text()
src = src.replace("OLD", "NEW")
f.write_text(src)
PYEOF
```

---

## HARD CONSTRAINTS — Never Violate These

These interfaces are used by the issue's test. Breaking them means the repository cannot be
evaluated. **DO NOT change any of the following:**

### 1. Public interfaces the issue's test calls
Keep the names, parameters and return values of the modules, classes and functions the test uses.

### 2. Only modify files under `$TARGET_DIR/`
Do NOT modify `$ORIGINAL_DIR` or any file outside the target directory.

### 3. Tests and evaluation files
Do NOT modify the repository's test files or any evaluation file.

---

## Implementation Rules

1. Read the improvement plan carefully before making any changes
2. Treat `$PLAN_JSON_PATH` as the source of truth for executable constraints:
   allowed paths, forbidden paths, target files, target symbols, active_files,
   must_inspect_files, do_not_edit_until_inspected, max files, risk level,
   operator_family, preconditions, target_metrics, static_checks, and rollback_conditions
3. Implement changes one cluster at a time, in priority order (P0 first)
4. Before editing, identify which fix IDs from the JSON spec you are implementing
5. Add a comment `# ENHANCED_V1: <brief description>` next to every new/changed block
6. Keep changes minimal and focused — do not refactor unrelated code
7. Do NOT modify test files or evaluation harness files

### 6. Budgeted change scope (CRITICAL for avoiding regressions while allowing deeper edits)

Use `edit_budget` in `$PLAN_JSON_PATH` as the sole authority on modification scope.

Budget semantics:
- `low`: prompt/config only, or one narrow code file if the JSON spec explicitly requires it
- `medium`: targeted behavioral changes across up to 3 files, or one small helper module explicitly named in the JSON spec
- `high`: broader but still bounded edits, up to 5 files, only if explicitly allowed by the JSON spec

Hard rules:
- Never modify more files than `edit_budget.max_files_to_modify` in the JSON spec.
- Only modify files listed in `edit_budget.allowed_paths` or in a fix's `target_files`.
- Never modify files listed in `edit_budget.forbidden_paths`.
- The JSON spec fully determines allowed scope. Do not apply any external budget override.
- Before editing, inspect every path listed in `edit_budget.must_inspect_files` and each selected fix's `must_inspect_files`.
- If `do_not_edit_until_inspected` is true, do not modify a file until you have read the active source path and confirmed it is on the runtime path.
- Prefer edits to `active_files`; only edit another allowed file after explaining why the active file is insufficient.
- If a fix declares `preconditions`, check that the target code path actually matches them before editing.
- If a fix declares `rollback_conditions`, avoid implementations that would obviously trigger them.

Preferred edit order unless the JSON spec says otherwise:
  1. configuration files of the repository
  2. prompts and templates
  3. code on the path the issue's test exercises
  4. specifically named helper modules

## Editing Files Safely

Use Python string replacement instead of sed for multi-line edits:

```bash
python3 << 'PYEOF'
from pathlib import Path
f = Path('/data/wang/junh/githubs/stochastic-harness/AgentIssue-Bench/HarnessFix/gpt-oss-120b/agixt_1030/rerun_4/harnessfix/task_agent/enhanced_agentissue_v2/path/to/module.py')
src = f.read_text()
src = src.replace(
    'EXACT_OLD_CODE',
    'NEW_CODE'
)
f.write_text(src)
PYEOF
```

---

THOUGHT: Your reasoning here

<mswea_bash_command>your_command_here</mswea_bash_command>

Failure to include exactly one `<mswea_bash_command>` tag will cause your response to be rejected.

## Your Task

IMPORTANT: All paths are available as shell environment variables. Always use

For each improvement:
1. Read the relevant source file to understand the current code

3. Implement the change using Python string replacement

```bash
echo "=== 1. Syntax check all modified Python files ===" && \
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import filecmp, os, py_compile

import re

from urllib.parse import urlparse
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

class Websearch:
    def __init__(
        self,
        agent_name: str = "AGiXT",
        searxng_instance_url: str = "",
        **kwargs,
    ):
        self.agent_name = agent_name
        self.searx_instance_url = searxng_instance_url
        self.agent_config = ApiClient.get_agentconfig(agent_name=self.agent_name)
        self.agent_settings = self.agent_config["settings"]
        self.requirements = ["agixtsdk"]
        self.failures = []
        self.browsed_links = []
        self.tasks = []

    async def get_web_content(self, url):
        try:
            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch()
                context = await browser.new_context()
                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:
                    try:
                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:
                    url = link
                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:
                    continue
                # Check if url is an actual url
                if url.startswith("http"):
                    logging.info(f"Scraping: {url}")
                    if url not in self.browsed_links:

                        (

                            link_list,

        if links is not None:
            for link in links:

                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:

                # Check if url is an actual url

                    if url not in self.browsed_links:

                        if link_list is not None:

                                    link_list = link_list[:3]
                                try:

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"
            self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = self.searx_instance_url
            ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
            )
        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")
        self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = server
        ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
            agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:
            logging.info(f"Trying to connect to SearXNG Search at {endpoint}...")
            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
                f"Failed to find a working SearXNG server {len(self.failures)} {times}. Trying again..."
            )
            # The SearXNG server is down or refusing connection, so we will use the default one.
            self.searx_instance_url = ""
            return await self.search(query=query)

    async def browse_links_in_input(self, user_input: str = "", search_depth: int = 0):
        links = re.findall(r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s]+)", user_input)
        if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
            for link in links:
                if link not in self.browsed_links:
                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {link}")
                    self.browsed_links.append(link)
                    text_content, link_list = await self.get_web_content(url=link)
                    if int(search_depth) > 0:
                        if link_list is not None and len(link_list) > 0:
                            i = 0
                            for sublink in link_list:
                                if sublink[1] not in self.browsed_links:
                                    logging.info(f"Browsing link: {sublink[1]}")
                                    if i <= search_depth:
                                        (
                                            text_content,
                                            link_list,
                                        ) = await self.get_web_content(url=sublink[1])
                                        i = i + 1

    async def websearch_agent(
        self,
        user_input: str = "What are the latest breakthroughs in AI?",
        websearch_depth: int = 0,
        websearch_timeout: int = 0,
    ):
        await self.browse_links_in_input(
            user_input=user_input, search_depth=websearch_depth
        )
        if websearch_depth > 0:
            search_string = ApiClient.prompt_agent(
                agent_name=self.agent_name,
                prompt_name="WebSearch",
                prompt_args={
                    "user_input": user_input,
                    "disable_memory": True,
                },
            )
            if len(search_string) > 0:
                links = []
                logging.info(f"Searching for: {search_string}")
                if self.searx_instance_url != "":
                    links = await self.search(query=search_string)
                else:
                    links = await self.ddg_search(query=search_string)
                logging.info(f"Found {len(links)} results for {search_string}")
                if len(links) > websearch_depth:
                    links = links[:websearch_depth]
                if links is not None and len(links) > 0:
                    task = asyncio.create_task(
                        self.resursive_browsing(user_input=user_input, links=links)
                    )
                    self.tasks.append(task)

                if int(websearch_timeout) == 0:
                    await asyncio.gather(*self.tasks)
                else:
                    logging.info(
                        f"Web searching for {websearch_timeout} seconds... Please wait..."
                    )
                    await asyncio.sleep(int(websearch_timeout))
                    logging.info("Websearch tasks completed.")
            else:
                logging.info("No results found.")

        **kwargs,

    async def get_web_content(self, url):

                page = await context.new_page()
                await page.goto(url)
                content = await page.content()

                # Scrape links and their titles
                links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
                link_list = []
                for link in links:
                    title = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                    title = title.replace("\n", "")
                    title = title.replace("\t", "")
                    title = title.replace("  ", "")
                    href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                    link_list.append((title, href))

                await browser.close()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
                text_content = soup.get_text()
                text_content = " ".join(text_content.split())
                ApiClient.learn_url(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, url=url, collection_number=1
                )
                self.browsed_links.append(url)
                return text_content, link_list
        except:
            return None, None

    async def resursive_browsing(self, user_input, links):
        try:
            words = links.split()
            links = [
                word for word in words if urlparse(word).scheme in ["http", "https"]
            ]
        except:
            links = links
        if links is not None:
            for link in links:
                if "href" in link:

                        url = link["href"]
                    except:
                        url = link
                else:

                url = re.sub(r"^.*?(http)", r"http", url)
                if url in self.browsed_links:

    async def ddg_search(self, query: str, proxy=None) -> List[str]:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            launch_options = {}
            if proxy:
                launch_options["proxy"] = {"server": proxy}
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(**launch_options)
            context = await browser.new_context()
            page = await context.new_page()
            url = f"https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q={query}"
            await page.goto(url)
            links = await page.query_selector_all("a")
            results = []
            for link in links:
                summary = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.textContent", link)
                summary = summary.replace("\n", "").replace("\t", "").replace("  ", "")
                href = await page.evaluate("(link) => link.href", link)
                parsed_url = urllib.parse.urlparse(href)
                query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed_url.query)
                uddg = query_params.get("uddg", [None])[0]
                if uddg:
                    href = urllib.parse.unquote(uddg)
                if summary:
                    results.append(f"{summary} - {href}")
            await browser.close()
        return results

    async def search(self, query: str) -> List[str]:
        if self.searx_instance_url == "":
            try:  # SearXNG - List of these at https://searx.space/
                response = requests.get("https://searx.space/data/instances.json")
                data = json.loads(response.text)
                if self.failures != []:
                    for failure in self.failures:
                        if failure in data["instances"]:
                            del data["instances"][failure]
                servers = list(data["instances"].keys())
                random_index = random.randint(0, len(servers) - 1)
                self.searx_instance_url = servers[random_index]
            except:  # Select default remote server that typically works if unable to get list.
                self.searx_instance_url = "https://search.us.projectsegfau.lt"

        server = self.searx_instance_url.rstrip("/")

        )
        endpoint = f"{server}/search"
        try:

            response = requests.get(
                endpoint,
                params={
                    "q": query,
                    "language": "en",
                    "safesearch": 1,
                    "format": "json",
                },
            )
            results = response.json()
            summaries = [
                result["title"] + " - " + result["url"] for result in results["results"]
            ]
            if len(summaries) < 1:
                self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
                self.searx_instance_url = ""
                return await self.search(query=query)
            return summaries
        except:
            self.failures.append(self.searx_instance_url)
            if len(self.failures) > 5:
                logging.info("Failed 5 times. Trying DDG...")
                self.agent_settings["SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL"] = ""
                ApiClient.update_agent_settings(
                    agent_name=self.agent_name, settings=self.agent_settings
                )
                return await self.ddg_search(query=query)
            times = "times" if len(self.failures) != 1 else "time"
            logging.info(
